ai_overview_references.title: Which websites AI engines read before naming a local business

answer_text:
Number of domain-day citations: Perplexity accumulated 5,839 domain-day citations across 670 answer-days from September 1 to September 27, 2026 (tracked through September 26 before collection methods shifted).
Where it is published: This data is published on Namebeam Markets in the report titled "Which websites AI engines read before naming a local business" and shared via Namebeam.
